desc:
🐺 Wolf Story

From the creators of Felandia and Sundown Island comes a new era of wolf roleplay.

Wolf Story is the spiritual successor to Sundown Island, inspired by classic wolf RPGs like Island of Mezaa (Furea) and Elements of Sukio (Lady_Abbyy).

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌿 Choose Your Affinity
Select your Affinity - a class-like system that shapes your wolf’s identity and future path.

💎 Collect Gems & Accessories
Explore the world to gather gems and unlock unique cosmetics to customize your wolf.

🌎 Explore the World
Discover forests, hidden areas, and mysterious locations across the land.

🐾 Roleplay Your Story
Create your wolf, form packs, build relationships, and tell your story.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠️ ALPHA STATE (Playable!)
Wolf Story is currently in active development.
